resale_co.name: Resale / Rental Inspection (Rental/Resale Application)
resale_co.issued_by: Tuckerton Borough Construction and Code Enforcement Office, serving Bass River under an interlocal service agreement
requirements: Yard free of debris and weeds, sheds empty; waterfront lots need bulkhead in good condition
Home clean and move-in ready, trash and hazardous material removed; paint, flooring, siding, roof, windows and screens in good condition
Attached garage walls and attic ceilings finished with 1/2 inch drywall (two layers of Type X under living space); rated doors
Stairs with graspable handrails and closed risers; decks and landings 30 inches or more above grade need 36 inch guardrails with openings under 4 inches
Smoke alarms to code (see fire certificate) and carbon monoxide alarm within 10 feet of all bedrooms
Electrical: no exposed wires, panel labeled, all boxes covered
Water heater relief valve piped to within 6 inches of the floor; heating equipment properly vented
House numbers at least 4 inches near the front door (not on the door), contrasting
Well water test by the Board of Health if on well water
Flood elevation certificate in special flood hazard areas
Certificates by professionals for chimneys, woodstoves, fireplaces, heat and hot water systems, elevation, bulkhead, and lead paint for homes built before 1978
Portable fire extinguisher, minimum 2A:10BC, 2.5 to 10 lb dry chemical, within 10 feet of the kitchen (still listed on the May 2026 form)
resale_co.how_to_apply: Download the Resale - Rental Application from the Bass River Forms page, check Resale Inspection, and submit it with payment (cash, check or money order) to the Tuckerton Borough Construction Office, 420 East Main Street, Tuckerton, NJ 08087. Inspections are done on Fridays only. Attach any required certifications (well water, chimney, woodstove, fireplace, heat and hot water, elevation, lead paint).
resale_co.contact_title: Housing Official / Code Enforcement Officer (Tuckerton Borough)

resale_co.notes: Bass River's own site sends sellers to a Resale - Rental Application, but the form is the Borough of Tuckerton's (Ocean County) form, run by Tuckerton's Construction and Code Enforcement office under Bass River's interlocal service agreement. Bass River's posted copy matches Tuckerton's form 'updated 5/26/2026'. Some checklist lines are Tuckerton-specific (for example no sleeping space on the third floor in Tuckerton Meadows). No Bass River ordinance requiring a resale certificate was found: the township code on Municode (Supplement 17, 2021) only requires a certificate of occupancy for rental units (Chapter 5.16, $25 first unit, $15 each additional unit, applied for through the municipal clerk). The only fee on the form is tied to the smoke, carbon monoxide and extinguisher certificate (see fire_cert); no separate resale housing inspection fee is published. The Tuckerton page routes web messages for Joe Ventresca to the technical assistant's address (LCranmer@TuckertonBorough.com). Confirm with the Tuckerton Construction Office whether the full resale checklist applies to Bass River properties or only the fire certificate items.

requirements: Ten-year sealed battery smoke alarms required where alarms are battery powered (effective January 1, 2019); hardwired alarms from original construction must stay hardwired
Smoke alarm rules by year built (1978 and before, 1979-1981, 1981-1987, 1987-1991, 1991 to present), with hardwired and interconnected alarms required for newer homes
Carbon monoxide alarm within 10 feet of the sleeping areas
Portable fire extinguisher, minimum 2A:10BC, 2.5 to 10 lb dry chemical, within 10 feet of the kitchen (form dated May 2026 still lists it)

fire_cert.notes: The NJ DCA is the fire code enforcing agency for Bass River (LEA registry code S; directory lists Fire Official Louis Kilmer, (609)633-6132). The DCA state-towns list (revised 7/17/2026) lists Bass River without the 'SC' (smoke certs) flag, so the state does not appear to issue smoke certificates here. Bass River's site instead posts the Tuckerton Borough Rental/Resale Application, whose first page is the smoke alarm, CO alarm and extinguisher certification with the fee schedule quoted. Under N.J.A.C. 5:70-2.3(a)1 a municipal resale inspection can stand in for the separate state certificate. The fee amounts were printed on a scanned form; digits were read from the image. The state law change of February 3, 2025 (P.L.2025, c.19) dropped the extinguisher from the state requirement, but this May 2026 form still lists it.

other_items.label: Well water test
other_items.detail: The form says a well water test must be completed by the Board of Health for homes on well water.

other_items.label: Professional certifications
other_items.detail: Attach certifications for well and septic, chimneys, woodstoves, fireplaces, heat and hot water systems, elevation, and lead paint if the home was built before 1978.

other_items.label: Rental certificate of occupancy (rentals only)
other_items.detail: Rental units need a township certificate of occupancy before each new occupancy, applied for through the municipal clerk (Chapter 5.16). Not a resale requirement.

Confirm whether the extinguisher is still required given P.L.2025, c.19; the May 2026 form still lists it.
